deadline.value: Applications can be submitted at any time, so there is no fixed closing date for this PhD.
deadline.quote: For other doctoral programmes, you can submit an Application for Admission at any time.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test requirement is stated on the department's doctoral page.

supervisor.value: The institute suggests finding a supervisor at the ABI before applying, rather than requiring one at application.
supervisor.quote: The best way to start is to find a supervisor at the ABI you would like to work with and research a project that suits your skills and interests.

funding.value: Funding comes through the competitive University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship; no guaranteed funding is stated.
funding.quote: The University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship (UoADS) is a competitive scholarship scheme in 4 rounds each year.

entry_route.value: Entry is typically a bachelor's degree with honours or a master's degree, with a significant research project and a B+ grade or above.
entry_route.quote: Typically, you need to have completed a significant research project (dissertation or thesis) as part of either a bachelor's degree with honours, e.g. BE(Hons) or BSc(Hons), or a masters degree.

notes: PhD is run by the Auckland Bioengineering Institute; the page gives no department-specific fee, GRE or English rule.
name: PhD in Bioengineering
